subject: Dedicated capacity sizing request — SpectraPay
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@spectrapay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T15:10:00Z
Subject: Dedicated capacity inquiry for live payments fraud detection

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the chat earlier — SpectraPay would like a dedicated deployment profile and a high-level sizing exercise for an upcoming pilot (Q4). We're evaluating Redwood Dedicated to run our fraud scoring and conversational support models (mix of classify, rerank, and short-generation outputs).

Key asks:
- Estimate GPU pool size (v100/80GB-equivalent or similar) and a recommended SKUs mix for a 6-month pilot.
- Guidance on expected latency at p50/p95/p99 for a 256-token input / 128-token generation target.
- Monthly unit-cost range for the pilot (ballpark is fine).

I attached an initial traffic sheet (SpectraPay_traffic_v1.xlsx) with weekly peaks and a short sample token export. We can provide more detail on prompt mix if that helps.

Timeline: procurement limited — we need a fast turnaround (1 week) to include in the vendor shortlist.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Director, Platform Engineering
SpectraPay

Attachment: SpectraPay_traffic_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@spectrapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity inquiry for live payments fraud detection

Hi Maria — thanks for sending this over and outlining the timeline. We're happy to move quickly. I've looped in Marissa (solutions) and Priyom (inference engineering) to run a short sizing workback.

To ensure the estimate is actionable for procurement, could you confirm a few items quickly:
1) Prompt mix: what percent of requests are reranking/classify/chat/generation?
2) Average prompt token length and median generation tokens per request for the generation bucket.
3) Expected sustained QPS vs 5-minute peak QPS and the p95/p99 concurrency you care about.
4) Target p99 latency SLO (e.g., <200ms, <500ms).
5) Any constraints (must be single-region, on-prem connector, strict IP allowlists).

If it's easier, Marissa can share a one-page preliminary worksheet; otherwise answer in-line and we'll produce a rapid workback by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Ben
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-09-13T09:30:00Z
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity inquiry for live payments fraud detection — preliminary sizing worksheet

Hi Maria,

Thanks — I pulled the traffic sheet and sketched a preliminary sizing estimate (attached). A few notes and clarifying questions inside the worksheet, but high level we assumed:
- Workload split: 55% classify/rerank, 30% short chat (limited generation), 15% longer generation (up to 128 tokens)
- Baseline daily active users: 18k; 99th percentile concurrency (across global peak window): ~160 concurrent sessions
- Target p99 latency: 400ms for classify/rerank, 800ms for generation (interactive is softer)

What I attached: RDW_prelim_sizing_v1.pdf — includes an SKU mix (8x A100-80GB equiv + 4x T4-style for low-cost batching), expected sustained throughput, and cost bands.

Open questions (in the PDF and below):
- Can you share a small sample of tokenized prompt/response pairs (we only need 200–500 rows) so we can validate token length assumptions?
- Do you require in-region data residency (we assumed us-east-1)?
- Expected retention of KV/prefix cache between requests (are you reusing context across sessions?)

If you confirm the three items above, Priyom and I can produce a tighter forecast (including queueing headroom and burst capacity plan) by tomorrow EOD.

Thanks —
Marissa
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: RDW_prelim_sizing_v1.pdf (pdf)

On 2028-09-12 16:05, Ben Carter wrote:
> Hi Maria — thanks for sending this over and outlining the timeline....
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@spectrapay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Anand Reddy <anand.reddy@spectrapay.com>
Date: 2028-09-13T13:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity inquiry for live payments fraud detection — token samples and constraints

Hi Marissa & team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the PDF — looks like the direction we expected. Answers inline below to your questions:

- Token samples: attached: spectrapay_token_sample.csv (300 rows) — includes tokenized prompt length, tokenized response length, and label of request type.
- Region: us-east-1 required for this pilot due to data locality and gateway routing.
- Cache/Context: for fraud scoring the requests are stateless (no KV reuse); for conversational support we persist the last 3 turns per user (average additional 90 tokens).
- Peak windows: daytime payment peak 14:00–15:30 ET, expect 1-minute peak QPS ~220, 5-minute sustained peak QPS ~140.
- SLOs: we need p95 latency <300ms for classify/rerank and p99 <700ms for generation to meet UX targets.

Procurement note: we target an internal vendor short-list by 2028-09-20 and a PO by 10/05 if vendor economics + security questionnaire line up.

Thanks,
Maria

Attachment: spectrapay_token_sample.csv (csv)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@spectrapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-14T18:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity inquiry for live payments fraud detection — next steps and tech review

Maria — great, thanks for the samples and timeline. Next steps:
1) Priyom will run a short simulation against the token sample and the traffic peaks to validate the SKU mix and produce a latency vs concurrency curve. Expect the simulation results + recommended SKU mix tomorrow morning.
2) We'll prepare a two-page procurement summary (cost bands, SKUs, SLA outline, and required security artifacts) and upload to the shared drive link above.
3) Can we schedule a 30-minute technical review on Monday (2028-09-18) with your infra team so we can validate network egress, VPC peering needs, and any KMS/HSM requirements?

Tentative pricing range based on the preliminary worksheet: $18k–$35k/month for the pilot (depends on reserved term and burst capacity), final number after simulation.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once Priyom posts the simulation. Deal reference: RDW-2028-4682. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/4682

Best,
Ben
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
